# Aesthetique Clinic

> Premium hair restoration and aesthetic clinic offering bespoke FUE, FUT and PRP therapy delivered by board-certified surgeons.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the clinic, results gallery, doctor profile, patient journey and FAQs.
- [Treatments](/treatments): Full menu of hair restoration and aesthetic services with details on duration and recovery.
- [Book a Consultation](/book-consultation): Free 3-step booking form to schedule a confidential consultation.
